title: OSTBC Combiner
text: 使用正交空时分组码合并输入，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Rounding mode} 指定定点计算的舍入模式；{Number of transmit antennas} 指定发射天线数量、{Rate} 指定符号率 3/4、{Number of receive antennas} 指定接收天线数量、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和、{Product Output} 指定分集合并中分子的复数乘积、{Accumulator} 指定分集合并中分子的求和、{Energy product output} 指定分母中的复数乘积、{Energy accumulator} 用于计算 MIMO 信道总能量的分母求和、{Division output} 按 MIMO 信道总能量进行归一化的分集合并，按实例取值。

ports.name: Rx
ports.summary: 接收信号 column vector | matrix | 3-D array

ports.name: cEst
ports.summary: 信道估计 matrix | 3-D array | 4-D array

params.name: Number of receive antennas
params.values: 接收天线数量 1 (default) | integer in range [1,8]

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 定点计算的舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Product Output
params.values: 分集合并中分子的复数乘积 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 分集合并中分子的求和 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Energy product output
params.values: 分母中的复数乘积 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Energy accumulator
params.values: 用于计算 MIMO 信道总能量的分母求和 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as accumulator | Inherit: Same as energy product output | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Division output
params.values: 按 MIMO 信道总能量进行归一化的分集合并 Inherit: Same as accumulator | fixdt(1,16,0) |
